purpose: Critical remaining ironman guide methods still thin or absent after multi-agent gap passes.

methods.level_range: 93+ Fishing; 90 Agility, Ranged, Strength for full waterfall route in normal game
methods.xp_rate: not normalized; high-level ironman/Prif route and crystal urchin point source
methods.intensity: active to semi-AFK depending on setup
methods.notes: Produces crystal urchin points used to buy the crystal fishing rod (3,000 points). Permanent tool unlock even when Deep Sea Frenzy is better raw XP. Hard Tirannwn/Prif dependency.

methods.xp_rate: not normalized
methods.notes: Starting-region high-level fish under Misthalin/City of Um working League mapping. Complements Deep Sea and Menaphos food loops.

methods.xp_rate: 4x bone XP when grinding + worshipping; rate depends on bone tier and logistics
methods.notes: Classic ironman Prayer engine before powder of burials or high-tier banked bones. First Age outfit (Morytania regional unlock) improves the route. Pairs with bone crusher / Underworld bone storage when available.

methods.level_range: Fort chapel tiers; scales with Construction/Fort progress
methods.xp_rate: multipliers reduced 0.5x in early-game rebalance; still strong with burners (tier-dependent)
methods.notes: Working Fort taxonomy is Misthalin (Catalyst-style) despite SE Wilderness geography. Burners retain offering-save chance. Complements powder of burials (Desert powder supply) and chaos altar (Forinthry).
methods.warning: Do not use pre-early-game-rebalance chapel multipliers.

methods.level_range: 75 Construction for gilded altar; burners for max multiplier
methods.xp_rate: up to 3.5x with burners on gilded altar
methods.notes: Self-sufficient ironman offering once Construction allows. Lower-tier POH altars were buffed in early-game rebalance.

methods.level_range: Rune Mythos / City of Um progression through 99+
methods.location: City of Um necromantic altars (spirit, bone, flesh, miasma)
methods.xp_rate: comparable to Abyss paths on ironman guidance; impure essence from rituals is the supply gate
methods.notes: Starting-region RC path once Necromancy/Um content is open. Impure essence from rituals replaces pure essence dependency for these runes. Strong League value because Misthalin is free.

methods.location: Wilderness Abyss entrance then blood altar
methods.xp_rate: legacy tables stale; re-benchmark post-110 and post-demonic-skull removal
methods.notes: Hard Forinthry dependency for Abyss entrance. Blood altar itself is multi-region geography but Abyss routing is the Forinthry pressure.
methods.warning: Ignore Demonic Skull rate assumptions still present on some guide pages.

methods.xp_rate: up to about 25,000 XP/day from dust exchange on current ironman notes
methods.notes: Daily-ish XP supplement while training Runespan (Misthalin portal access).

methods.xp_rate: daily-gated; strong early levels
methods.notes: Ironman Farming guide early path. Anachronia region pick.

methods.xp_rate: continuous mid-level Farming XP; not pure herb XP
methods.notes: Desert continuous Farming XP between herb runs. Synergizes with powder of burials whirligig area.

methods.method: Standard herb and tree patch runs
methods.xp_rate: time-gated; high time-efficiency
methods.notes: Core self-sufficient herb supply for Herblore. Region value scales with number of unlocked patches (Asgarnia Falador, Morytania Phasmatys, Kandarin Ardougne/Catherby, Desert, Tirannwn, etc.). Pair with Master Farmers and seedicide.

methods.xp_rate: passive; notable with vyres and high seed density tasks
methods.notes: Toolbelt seedicide converts seed drops to Farming XP. Strong with Morytania vyre multi-skill training.

methods.method: Herblore Habitat seed and shop supply
methods.xp_rate: supply-focused rather than pure XP/h
methods.notes: Papa Mambo / jadinko favour seed and herb-related supply for ironmen.

methods.location: Any multi-player bonfire or permanent bonfire
methods.xp_rate: scales with log tier; Miscellania (Fremennik) supplies bulk mid logs
methods.notes: Standard ironman FM path before sharp shell shards / eternal magic / curly roots. Permanent bonfires: Yeti Town, Prif Tower of Voices (log save), Max Guild.

methods.level_range: any with logs; benefits with Prif access
methods.xp_rate: standard bonfire rates plus log-save chance on the permanent fire
methods.notes: Tirannwn permanent bonfire convenience for ironmen training FM while based in Prif.

methods.xp_rate: primary pre-safecracking ironman path; lower than Fremennik/Menaphite pickpockets at 50+
methods.notes: Starting-region early Thieving. Switch to Fremennik citizen / Menaphite marketeer pickpocketing around 50-62 then safecracking.

methods.location: Lumbridge / Ardougne bakery stalls and early pickpocket targets
methods.xp_rate: low; quest and stall path into Thieves' Guild
methods.notes: Earliest Thieving before guild doors. Ardougne stalls may pressure Kandarin if used long.

methods.location: Prifddinas clan districts under Voice of Seren
methods.xp_rate: lower pure XP than heists/chests; ironman loot includes potions and porter components
methods.notes: Not meta XP after heists, but League-valuable for supplies. Crystal Mask + Light Form (Tirannwn) stack.

methods.location: Draynor willows, Varrock oaks, Lumbridge trees
methods.xp_rate: early ladder rates; not endgame
methods.notes: Starting-region early WC before creeping ivy / acadia / teaks.

methods.level_range: 83 Archaeology for relic; any WC level after
methods.location: Relic power (Archaeology monolith); used while cutting anywhere
methods.xp_rate: not a standalone XP method; changes FM/WC interaction
methods.notes: Orthen/Anachronia Archaeology relic pressure. Auto-burns logs while woodcutting (compare Superheat Form Tirannwn prayer path).

methods.method: Orikalkum skip note for ironman burial path
methods.xp_rate: ironman guides often skip bulk orikalkum because mine time makes it worse than rune despite higher XP/bar
methods.notes: Keep burial smithing at Artisans' Workshop. Prefer efficient bar tiers for no-trading; primal burial needs Forinthry Daemonheim ores at 100+ Mining.

methods.xp_rate: not XP; unlock order
methods.notes: Typical ironman order: blacksmith outfit pieces first, then solemn smith / repairs / ceremonial as needed. Outfit is Asgarnia-hard for self-sufficient XP boost.

methods.level_range: black mask early; focus sight / hexcrest / spectral lens on-task mid
methods.location: Cave horrors (black mask); desert strykewyrms (focus sight); jungle strykewyrms (hexcrest); profane scabarites (spectral lens)
methods.xp_rate: not pure Slayer XP; equipment progression
methods.notes: Region pressure: black mask often Karamja/Mos Le'Harmless cluster; focus sight Desert; hexcrest Karamja jungle; spectral lens Desert scabarites. Assemble full slayer helmet for accuracy/damage.

methods.xp_rate: doubles Slayer points from standard masters
methods.notes: Global points economy unlock gated by Desert questline. Affects every master after completion.

methods.level_range: any after points available; Fletching for broad arrows
methods.location: Any Slayer master shop after unlock
methods.xp_rate: enables broad arrow ironman Fletching path
methods.notes: Cross-skill: Slayer points buy broad fletching so ironmen can train Fletching on weekly broad arrowheads.

methods.xp_rate: starter charm bank only
methods.notes: Starts Summoning pouch ladder without combat charms.

methods.location: Croesus (Misthalin working), charming moths (Forinthry), waterfiends, exiled kalphites (Desert), celestial dragons (Morytania), general Slayer
methods.xp_rate: supply-limited; not a fixed XP/h
methods.notes: No-trading League: region picks that open dense charm camps unlock Summoning throughput. Pair with charming imp (Forinthry DG).

methods.method: Pouch ladder summary (early to pack yak)
methods.location: Any summoning obelisk (Taverley Asgarnia, Menaphos Desert, Amlodd Tirannwn, Havenhythe shrine)
methods.xp_rate: varies by pouch; geyser titan remains high-end XP when materials allow
methods.notes: Progress dreadfowl through mid pouches to pack yak using charm+tertiary supply. Do not assume portable deposit boxes for peak geyser titan rates in Equilibrium.
methods.warning: 11.7m geyser titan figures assume main-game portable setups.

methods.location: Moonrise Dig Site fang + archaeologist's workbench
methods.xp_rate: one-time unlock (5,222.2 Arch XP on combine)
methods.notes: Moonstone ring + restored Fang of Kayazu. Effect: +80% additive soul attraction on rituals; 20% chance to double ritual disturbance item rewards. Necromancy utility, not combat BiS ring.
